notes.title: We've been Greenlit!
notes.notes:
G Prime is now LIVE on Steam! 

After first launching on Xbox earlier this year, we went back to the drawing board and came back with a ship-full of new features, including:

- An in-depth tutorial and Space station walkthrough
- Updated camera view options
- Dazzling new artwork
- An intuitive new scorecard
